Alexandra Maniego Eala [ a ] (born May 23, 2005) is a Filipino professional tennis player. She reached a career-high WTA singles ranking of world No. 31 on February 23, 2026, making her the highest-ranked Filipino in WTA Tour history. She is also the first Filipino to break into the top 50, defeating multiple top-5 players and major champions, and reached a tour-level final in the Open Era . Eala reached an ITF junior combined ranking of world No. 2 on October 6, 2020, and became the first Filipino to win a major junior title by claiming the girls' singles category at the 2022 US Open . Early life and background [ edit ] Alexandra Maniego Eala was born on May 23, 2005, in Quezon City , Philippines, to Mike Eala, a businessman, and Rizza Maniego-Eala , Globe Telecom chief financial officer until 2024, and a former national swimmer who earned a bronze medal in the 1985 SEA Games 100-meter backstroke . Eala is a niece of former Philippine Sports Commission chairperson and Philippine Basketball Association
